en: Vintage sepia postcard showing the ornate main gate and façade of a large historic academy building. The entrance gate has brick pillars with decorative lamps and an iron arch, with uniformed figures and civilians standing in front. The upper part of the image is overlaid with handwritten text. Printed captions in Hungarian read "Pécs" in the upper left and "Hadapród iskola főbejárata" in the upper right. The reverse side contains dense handwritten correspondence in German, address lines, postal markings, and a vertical imprint of the Budapest publisher dated 1917.
